repos.name: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search
repos.description: The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews. Fork it and own it.
repos.one_liner: An AI-driven job application framework that automates the evaluation of postings, CV tailoring, and interview preparation.
bullets: Built on top of Claude Code for high-fidelity LLM interaction.
Automates the end-to-end job search lifecycle including cover letter generation and interview prep.
Runs locally on the user's machine to ensure data privacy and ownership of the application process.
Ideal for professionals looking to scale their job search efforts using agentic workflows.

repos.name: Leonxlnx/unlazy
repos.description: Anti-laziness skill for AI agents. Core: the Depth Tree method, which splits a task N layers deep and gives every leaf the full time budget of the whole task, so effort multiplies with depth. Grounded in 2025-2026 research on model laziness, underthinking and premature completion.
repos.one_liner: An anti-laziness framework for AI agents utilizing the Depth Tree method to maximize task execution quality.
bullets: Implements the 'Depth Tree' method to recursively split complex tasks into granular sub-tasks.
Allocates full-task time budgets to leaf nodes to force deep reasoning and prevent LLM 'laziness'.
Designed to improve the output quality of autonomous agents in complex coding or research tasks.
Highly relevant for developers building agentic systems that require high-accuracy, multi-step reasoning.

repos.name: floci-io/floci
repos.description: Light, fluffy, and always free - The AWS Local Emulator alternative
repos.one_liner: A lightweight, open-source local emulator for AWS services designed to replace heavy infrastructure dependencies.
bullets: Java-based architecture providing a fast, local alternative to cloud-based AWS environments.
Reduces infrastructure costs and latency during the development and testing phases of cloud-native apps.
Supports local integration testing for fintech and enterprise applications requiring AWS parity.
Simplifies devops workflows by eliminating the need for constant cloud connectivity.

repos.name: AgriciDaniel/claude-obsidian
repos.description: Self-organizing AI second brain for Obsidian + Claude Code. Drop any source and Claude reads, links, and files it into one connected knowledge graph of plain Markdown you own. AI note-taking, personal knowledge management (PKM), and an open-source Notion alternative. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern.
repos.one_liner: A self-organizing AI second brain that integrates Claude Code with Obsidian for automated knowledge management.
bullets: Uses Claude Code to parse, link, and categorize unstructured data into a Markdown-based knowledge graph.
Enables automated personal knowledge management (PKM) for researchers and tech professionals.
Maintains data sovereignty by storing all information in local, plain-text Markdown files.
Transforms disparate notes and documents into a searchable, interconnected intelligence layer.

repos.name: VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills
repos.description: A curated collection of 1000+ agent skills from official dev teams and the community, compatible with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, and more.
repos.one_liner: A massive, curated repository of 1000+ agent skills compatible with major CLI tools like Claude Code and Cursor.
bullets: Provides a standardized library of 'skills' that extend the capabilities of LLM-based agents.
Cross-compatible with popular agentic frameworks including Gemini CLI, Codex, and Claude Code.
Accelerates the development of specialized agents by providing pre-built, community-vetted logic.
Essential infrastructure for developers building modular, high-utility agentic systems.
